Quiz rules/start

/courses/:courseId/quizzes/:quizId
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S10, S16

Present the published quiz window, personal allowance, attempt policy and integrity disclosure before starting a time-bound attempt. Starting creates an attempt; browsing the rules does not.

Rules headerQuiz title, course, question count/points and published version; Personal open/close, course window and timezone
Policy summaryPersonal duration, attempt count, score-selection and release rules; Allowed materials, AI prohibition where applicable, disclosed integrity signals
Start panelResume existing attempt or confirm new attempt; Connectivity/device requirements and technical recovery instructions

Keep reading rulesStart attempt now
Permissions
  • Learner can start only own eligible attempt.
  • TA cannot alter quiz window, allowance policy or release.
  • Focus/visibility events are never proof of cheating and cannot auto-cancel an attempt.
Responsive
  • Rules precede Start on narrow web; timing summary remains readable.
  • Large tables of rules become definition lists.
Accessibility
  • Timing is explained in text before acknowledgement.
  • No keyboard trap/fullscreen dependency; institution-approved accessibility timing exceptions are surfaced.
Data
  • Published quiz version, personal timing, own attempt status and release rule.
  • Integrity disclosure and allowed tools/materials; no answer keys on rules page.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Opening or refreshing rules does not consume an attempt.
  • A timed-out start resolves an existing attempt before offering another Start.
  • Course AI prohibition is shown even if W11 lists an eligible AI tool.
  • Starting 9 minutes before personal close warns that the remaining window is 9 minutes even when personal timer duration is 30; start records that earlier effective deadline.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
  • Proposed quiz deadline = earlier of personal close and startedAt + effective duration; untimed quiz ends at personal close. Show a shortened window before Start. Use one timer allowance mode (extra minutes OR multiplier), not both. At expiry finalize only acknowledged answers; unsent offline text remains a recoverable local draft requiring staff review, never a fake accepted receipt.
